$comment: id -> { photo, credit }. The photo each reveal card shows, picked by eye from contact sheets with scripts/reveal-photos.mjs (herping candidates, then pick): CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC, credited on the card. photo is iNaturalist's 500 px copy, which the toy preloads; the card swaps in the 1024 px copy when it opens. If a photo fails to load the card falls back to the pixel sprite.
